summary: Iter 207 backend + frontend regression for Finance↔Accounting orphaned-JE repair. All 9 pytest cases pass (repair endpoint shape + idempotency + RBAC 403, donation delete cascade, expense delete cascade, bulk-delete donations/expenses with je_reversed counter, empty-ids 400). Frontend Repair Orphans button verified on /accounting: confirm dialog opens, POST /api/financial/repair-orphaned-journals returns 200 (scanned=202, orphans_found=193, reversed=0, already_reversed=193 — idempotent state as expected from prior main-agent run), toast shows the server message. Trial Balance shows Balanced.
critical_code_review_comments: financial.py:_reverse_auto_posted_je correctly guards on status=='posted' and is_reversed check → safe on re-run.
repair_orphaned_journals correctly scoped to auto_generated_from ∈ {donation,expense} — never touches manual JEs. Good.
delete_donation / delete_expense / bulk variants call the reverse helper BEFORE deleting the source row — correct ordering so _reverse_auto_posted_je can still find the JE via source_id.

AccountingPage.jsx repairOrphanedJournals uses window.confirm (not shadcn AlertDialog). Consistent with the neighbouring repairReversalLines handler; acceptable but could be upgraded for UX consistency.
No new file-size or DRY concerns introduced by this iteration.
test_credentials: admin@5812uganda.org / Admin@5812; ephemeral TEST_iter207_staff_* user created for RBAC test.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_iter207_* donations and expenses created + deleted during tests. All prefixed TEST_ for cleanup; net effect on DB is zero rows (all created rows subsequently deleted, their auto-JEs reversed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repair endpoint has already reversed all pre-existing orphans (193 of them). Any new tests calling the endpoint should expect reversed=0 unless they intentionally create+delete donations/expenses first. The endpoint is admin-only (403 for staff). Delete-cascade for expenses only reverses a JE when the expense was approved (only status where auto-post happens). The frontend Repair Orphans button is at data-testid=acc-repair-orphans-btn next to acc-repair-reversals-btn in AccountingPage.jsx line ~567.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Original Finance↔Accounting drift RCA (documented by main agent): deletes in Finance didn't cascade-reverse the auto-posted JEs, leaving Trial Balance ≠ Finance totals. Fix (delete handlers + repair-orphaned-journals endpoint) confirmed working.
